notes: An FM broadcast station carrying RDS. Not the house sample rate:
2.048 MS/s, because the multiplex runs to 57 kHz on a carrier that
deviates 75 kHz and the discriminator wants room for both.
Measured: the 19 kHz pilot stands 48.8 dB over the floor at exactly
19000.00 Hz, the RDS band 13 dB over it, and the RDS carrier itself
only 5.6 dB, which is what a suppressed carrier looks like.
It decodes to programme identification 0x8343 and the programme
service name TSF, over 18 groups in these two seconds. Three facts
from three different places agree: the name, from group 0A; the
programme type, from block 2 of every group, which reads 'news' and
TSF Radio Noticias is a news station; and the identification's top
nibble, 8, which is the country and which the other station recorded
at this site the same evening (0x8442, at 87.7 MHz) also carries.
TSF is national and permanent, so this can always be recorded again.
